Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

goalkeeper noun

also goalie, keeper, goaltender

modern

Traupman 48, 50
M-O s.v. football positions: goalkeeper, goalie (Albert)

portārius, portāriī m.

noun, second declension

In the Vulgate a doorkeeper or porter (Lewis & Short); Traupman’s word for the goalkeeper at football and hockey, with the feminine portāria.

Other words

  • portae custōs

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. football positions: goalkeeper, goalie (Egger)

    “Guardian of the goal”, in plain classical words.

See also goal, score a goal, football, team.
